title: Main-thread time and network in a Seebra session
summary: Long animation frames, the scripts and spans in them, canvas moves, interactions, page fetches and resources from one browser session, and which of them cost the frame budget.

concepts.label: Frame budget
concepts.description: 16.7 ms per frame at 60 Hz: input, script, style, layout and paint must fit in it for motion to look smooth.

children.label: Long animation frame
children.description: A frame that took 50 ms or more from its start to its paint (LoAF API).

facts.text: The Long Animation Frames API reports frames of 50 ms or more with the scripts that ran in them.

children.label: Blocking time
children.description: The part of a long frame over 50 ms during which input had to wait.

concepts.label: Script attribution
concepts.description: Which script spent a long frame: its source URL, function, how it was invoked, and its forced style and layout.

children.label: Third-party script
children.description: Code from another origin: analytics, consent, payments, fonts, trackers.

children.label: Seebra span
children.description: A named piece of Seebra's own work (a graph draw, the runtime's spec) marked by perf.cljs; the frame's longest span names the component.

concepts.label: Canvas interaction
concepts.description: Pans, zooms and drags of the canvas (perf/interacting!), and clicks and keys (Event Timing).

children.label: Interaction to Next Paint
children.description: How long an interaction waited for the next paint; the slowest one estimates INP.

facts.text: INP of 200 ms or less is good; over 500 ms is poor.

concepts.label: Network resource
concepts.description: A file or answer the browser fetched (Resource Timing): origin, initiator type, duration, time to first byte, size.

children.label: Page fetch
children.description: A fetch() from the page itself (not the data worker); during a canvas move it is a bug.

concepts.label: Page load milestones
concepts.description: Time to first byte, first paint, first contentful paint, largest contentful paint.

facts.text: LCP of 2.5 s or less is good.
